noun_definition: A Lightbox Component is a user interface element that displays images or content in an overlay, allowing users to view them in a focused manner.
noun_functionality: The Lightbox Component manages the visibility and loading of images, handles scaling and fallback images, and integrates with carousel functionality to enhance user experience.

noun_definition: Box model style refers to the CSS properties that define the layout and spacing of an element, including border, margin, padding, and background color.
noun_functionality: The function extracts and utilizes the box model style to apply layout properties to the rendered code block, ensuring proper spacing and appearance.

noun_definition: A text input box is a user interface element that allows users to enter and edit text.
noun_functionality: The text input box is responsible for capturing user input, managing the draft message, and handling text updates, including emoji insertion and selection management.
